name: @ocs/checksum
//: The pre-CRC checksums: sums, XOR, LRC, BCC, Fletcher and Adler-32. A separate family from @ocs/crc because a sum and a polynomial division are different ideas, not two strengths of one — see the note on ToolFamily. One tool per named checksum rather than one tool with a variant dropdown, because the names are what people search for and there are nine of them, not sixty-seven. `./manifests` is eager and dependency-free; `./definition` is the on-demand half that reaches @ocs/algos.
